about: Reviewed list of product names that are not drugs. 'not_drug', 'supplement' and 'other_drug' (medicines with no effect on obesity, e.g. anaesthetics, antibiotics, blood-pressure drugs, contraceptives in drug-interaction studies) entries stay in the database but are left out of the drug list, dashboard counts, search and the auto-fill (products.kind). 'merge' folds duplicate pages of the same drug into one (like 'Merge' on a drug page). 'drug' lists names that must stay in the drug list even if a name rule would hide them. Applied on every auto-fill run (npm run enrich-products) or with npm run curate-products. A choice made on a drug page always wins over this file.
